A Superb A Rated Family Home in an Unrivalled Location

Byrne Malone Estate Agents are delighted to introduce to the market this exceptional 4/5-bedroom semi-detached family home, perfectly positioned on the foothills of the Dublin Mountains. Offering generous accommodation, excellent living space and a fantastic rear garden, this beautiful property is sure to appeal to families seeking a quality home in a superb location.

Upon entering, the ground floor immediately impresses with a bright and welcoming living room, guest W.C., utility room with excellent additional storage and a stunning kitchen/dining room. Double doors lead us out to a beautiful pergola creating the perfect outdoor space for entertaining, relaxing or enjoying evenings with family and friends all year round.

The first floor provides a second reception room, two bedrooms and a family bathroom, while the second floor boasts a spacious master bedroom with en-suite and a further fourth bedroom. All bedrooms are complemented by fitted wardrobes, providing excellent storage throughout.

To the front, the property enjoys a lovely outlook over a large green area with a childrenâ€™s play area, making this an ideal setting for family life.
The location is truly exceptional. Saggart village is within walking distance, while Citywest Shopping Centre and the Luas Red Line are virtually on the doorstep. There is also an abundance of schools, shops, restaurants, sporting facilities, parks and beautiful nature trails nearby, with the Dublin Mountains offering endless opportunities for walking and exploring.

This is truly a beautiful home in a stunning location and needs to be seen to be appreciated.
